question:
**Identify the option that can be substituted as the correct idiom for the underlined part of the given sentence.**

As soon as the principal came to know about the inspection in the school, he put everything __in perfect order.__
solution:
The correct answer is: '**Apple pie order**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• '**Apple pie order**' means everything is in perfect order or arranged neatly. (सब कुछ सही क्रम में है या बड़े करीने से व्यवस्थित है)

 
 
• **Example**: *After cleaning and organizing, the kitchen was in apple pie order.*
